content_sections.heading: About OAV Sansole
content_sections.text: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Sansole is a school at Shamakhunta in Mayurbhanj district, working under the Department of School and Mass Education, Govt. of Odisha. Its letterhead gives CBSE Affiliation No. 1520196, School Code 17282 and UDISE Code 21072009602. The two Assistant Cook posts are support staff posts for the school's Boys' Hostel.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Fill in the prescribed form: post applied for, name, father's / husband's name, date of birth, age, marital status, Aadhar number, category (UR / SEBC / SC / ST), gender, religion, nationality, permanent and present address, educational qualifications, contact numbers and e-mail ID (if any). Sign the declaration on the form, with date and place. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures and tick the ones enclosed. Superscribe the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT COOK IN BOYS HOSTEL". Send the filled-in application with all documents to: PRINCIPAL ODISHA ADARSHA VIDYALAYA, AT- SANSOLE, PO - RANGAMATIA, VIA - SHAMAKHUNTA, DIST- MAYURBHANJ, PIN - 757049, ODISHA. Use Speed / Registered post only, so that the application reaches the Vidyalaya by 25/11/2026, 5 PM. The authority will not be responsible for any postal delay, so the date that counts is the date the application is received, not the date it is posted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application form asks for details of Matric/HSC, Inter/+2, B.A./B.Sc. and any other examination passed, and the HSC, +2 and B.A./B.Sc. certificates are to be attached "if any". Must be in position to stay in the hostel 24x7. Must be well conversant of using LPG. Must have good cooking habits. Ability to cook any dishes on time with due care towards hygiene and deliciousness. Preference and due weightage will be given to the individual trained in cookery. Preference shall be given to local candidates. If candidates are not available in that locality, the block will be taken as a unit. If candidates are still not available, candidates from nearby blocks may be selected. No candidates from outside the district should be engaged against the post. The remuneration is Rs 6750/- per month, and this amount includes the EPF share of both the employee and the employer. The engagement is for one year. On expiry of the one-year period, a fresh engagement shall be made with a gap of at least one working day, based on the satisfactory performance of the employee. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Assistant Cook post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents are to be attached to the application: HSC Certificate & Mark Sheet, if any +2 Certificate & Mark Sheet, if any B.A. / B.Sc. Certificate & Mark Sheet, if any Caste Certificate, if applicable Aadhar Card Residential Certificate Experience Certificate in Hostel Management, if any Passport size photograph (2 Nos.) Any other document (to be mentioned in the form)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection follows the "Modalities for selection of Assistant Cook for Boys' Hostel", which award points under two parameters: local candidates and efficiency level. Efficiency level carries a maximum of 2 points and is to be assessed by members of SLSC during document verification. It covers physical aptitude, hygiene consciousness, technical skill, reliability, experience in cookery, ability to stay 24x7, ability to handle critical situations, confidence, behaviour, team spirit and responsibility.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in OAV Sansole Assistant Cook Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 Assistant Cook vacancies in the Boys' Hostel of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Sansole, Shamakhunta, Mayurbhanj.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the OAV Sansole Assistant Cook application?
faq.answer: The application must be received by 25/11/2026 by 5 PM through Speed / Registered post. Applications received after the due date are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the OAV Sansole Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 32 years as on the date of advertisement, which is dated 05/11/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an OAV Sansole Assistant Cook?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs 6750/- per month, including the EPF share of the employee and the employer.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the OAV Sansole Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form, attach self-attested documents and send it by Speed / Registered post to the Principal, Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, At- Sansole, PO - Rangamatia, Via - Shamakhunta, Dist- Mayurbhanj, PIN - 757049, Odisha.

faq.question: Q6. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be superscribed with "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ASSISTANT COOK IN BOYS HOSTEL".

faq.question: Q7. How will Assistant Cooks be selected at OAV Sansole?
faq.answer: Candidates get points for local residence (Post Office, block, adjacent block and district) and up to 2 points for efficiency level, assessed by members of SLSC during document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for the OAV Sansole Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: Only male candidates are invited, and they must be able to stay in the hostel 24x7. Preference goes to local candidates, and no candidates from outside the district should be engaged.

faq.question: Q9. Is the OAV Sansole Assistant Cook job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is for one year. After that, a fresh engagement is made with a gap of at least one working day, based on satisfactory performance.
